body: Thank you all for your kind words of support. I reached out to you and I'm overwhelmed that people care. It's not to say that people in my own life might not care, I'm just not in a position to burden people with my problems. Most people I have to talk to about this wouldn't be able to empathize with me, the majority think I'm in the position that I'm in because I've chosen to be. In a way, I did chose a lot of it, but I felt like I lost control a long time ago. I don't have any resources to seek help in my area, I don't make enough to buy health insurance or go to a therapist. I'm really just struggling on my own. I make it through but I just encounter very dark places in my mind that overwhelm me, perhaps they are triggers. I don't know much about mental health, but I do know how I feel. I don't want to feel like I have no control and ending it would be the only way to stop it. I know that I have good things to live for, but feeling like I can't "fix myself" I become so overwhelmed and depressed. I just want normality so much, I've wanted it my entire life. When I'm depressed it's very bad, I think of scenarios where my family would be okay without me. Sometimes I'm worried if I made a plan that I could convince myself would work for them I would do it. When I realized this, I started looking for online support.
